//Otlp: Unset on purpose: with no collector the spans are still created and their trace id still reaches every log line, so the sample traces itself with nothing installed. Set Otlp:Endpoint (or OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT) to http://localhost:4317 to send them somewhere - see deploy/observability.
//Stores: Unset on purpose: the document store falls back to memory, which is what makes the sample runnable with no database. Set Stores:Document to a MongoDB connection string to persist.
//Temporal: Unset on purpose: the workflow worker only starts once Temporal:TargetHost is configured. The workflow and its activities compile either way, so the saga cannot rot unnoticed while the worker is switched off.
